capabilities: Sync vault files to a private GitHub repository via the REST API
Preserve both versions of concurrently edited files as timestamped conflict files
Batch changes into atomic commits with rate-limit throttling and cooldowns
Exclude folders or files via comma-separated patterns
Run connectivity diagnostics and health checks on the repository
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free and open source; errors are logged locally with tokens redacted and must be shared manually.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid service and Git-based community sync plugins need a local Git CLI or heavy WebAssembly modules, which is awkward especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: transmitted directly and exclusively to the official GitHub REST API (api.github.com)

requires.name: GitHub fine-grained Personal Access Token with Contents read/write

summary: GitHub-based vault synchronization plugin that syncs notes across desktop and mobile via the GitHub REST API with 3-way merge and conflict-file preservation.
